4.30pm. to keep in touch with our offers and to see pictures of our stock don’t forget our facebook page @oldandnewatno5parish of ballymoney& derrykeighancauseway family of parishes2nd august 2026 nineteenth sunday of ordinary timekeep your eyes on jesus in this week's gospel, jesus walks across the sea of galilee to his frightened apostles during a storm. peter, full of faith, steps out of the boat to walk towards him — but when he takes his eyes off jesus and looks instead at the wind and waves, he begins to sink. jesus reaches out and saves him, gently asking, "why did you doubt?”life brings storms of its own — worry, illness, family strain, ﬁnancial pressure — that can leave us feeling like we're sinking. this gospel reminds us that jesus is always with us in the midst of them, inviting us to keep our eyes ﬁxed on him rather than on our fears. as st peter later wrote, "cast all your anxieties on him, for he cares about you.” may the lord help us grow in faith and protect us whenever we feel we’re underwater.

54. hymns for mass christ be beside me, christ be before me, christ be behind me, king of my heart. christ be within me, christ be below me, christ be above me, never to part. christ on my right hand, christ on my left hand, christ all around me, shield in the strife. christ in my sleeping, christ in my sitting, christ in my rising, light of my life. christ be in all hearts thinking about me, christ be on all tongues telling of me. christ be the vision in eyes that see me, in ears that hear me, christ ever be.praise, my soul, the king of heaven; to his feet thy tribute bring. ransomed, healed, restored, forgiven, who like me his praise should sing? praise him, praise him, praise him, praise him, praise the everlasting king.praise him for his grace and favour to our fathers in distress. praise him still the same forever, slow to chide, and swift to bless. praise him, praise him, praise him, praise him, glorious in his faithfulness.feast of the assumption next saturday is 15th august, the feast of our lady’s assumption into heaven. it is a holy day of obligation. mass will be celebrated in ballymoney at 10am and 6pm. masses times for the other local parishes can be seen in the panel opposite.
